origin: SOLID principles as conditional derivatives of generative object-oriented structure; do not promote generic state-adequacy experiments as the scientific object.

world_domain.excluded_confound: unknown filter field semantics differ in historical revisions

source_changes_to_compare: JOINT: Add Team as third filterable field used by both ingestion and display; requires filter model and matching, jobboard/store conversion, SQLite constraint/migration on old and fresh installations, UI selection or explicit programmatic API admission; common behavioral oracle for both architectures.

DIVERGENT: Freeze an independently justified ingestion-vs-display semantic exception using a separate observable demand. If no externally justified exception is found, mark this contrast HOLD and do not invent one merely to get reversal.
competitive_hypotheses: H_loc: shared authority can reduce independent field mapping obligations when both consumers need the same new field semantics
H_cong: semantic congruence moderates H_loc; shared boundary may impose adapters or branching when duties diverge
H_simple: file count, dependency fanout or naive changed-site count explains all apparent effects without a novel structural primitive
required_treatment_controls: same initial externally visible behavior over valid current filters
both realized structural variants meet the complete frozen Team requirement including schema and user workflow or documented scoped programmatic demand
same Go toolchain and version pinned
same complete functional tests, plus cross-consumer parity and unknown-field negative control
no edits to upstream repo or production data; disposable source clones
retain pre-action ownership diagrams and independently inspect treatment diffs
follow-up changes included, initial implementation only cannot establish lifetime effect
report S,L,C,A,Q and separate compilation/functional-failure coordinates
compare against coupling-only and changed-site-only model
report sign/Pareto on frozen channel and support; if no reversal, reject that prediction

outcome_authority.mainline_pass: requires real source action with full behavior oracle and directional prediction
outcome_authority.negative: if simpler model is equally predictive or original source lacks controlled semantics, downgrade extra-ontology claim
outcome_authority.abstain: if UI/schema incomplete or demand divergence fabricated, HOLD

novelty_ceiling: An unreplicated one-repository change comparison is not publishable generative OO theory. Conditional cross-demand signed-vector prediction that surpasses simpler coupling/DSM explanations would be the first defensible novel result.
